name: Salt and Stone
desc: A small browser climbing game: two sandstone towers above the sea, one hand-built route to the top. Tap a hold, see the projected trajectory and strength cost, then commit to a reach, a jump or a step back — and spend your strength wisely. A hand-designed route with no generator, a body with fixed bone lengths and whole-body collision against the rock, stamina, rest ledges and falls. Made for phones in portrait mode; plain ES modules and Canvas 2D, no runtime dependencies, no network requests.
controls: Tap/click a hold in a ring to preview its trajectory and strength cost, then press the move button to confirm; rest ledges recover strength
creator: tslava
